capabilities: Convert selection case between upper, lower, title, sentence, camel, snake, kebab and slug forms
Clean up pasted text by joining wrapped lines, rejoining hyphen-split words, removing invisible characters and replacing ligatures
Run configurable Tidy cleanup steps over a selection or the whole note, optionally on paste
Define saved find-and-replace commands with regex and case options
Sort, deduplicate and trim lines in a selection or note
extras: The README documents the exact bugs inherited from the original plugin that this rebuild fixes, each covered by a test. It also lists many other plugins by the same author, some with optional paid Pro versions, none of which apply to this plugin. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This is a rebuild of the uncontested half of Text Format, whose last release was in July 2024.
motivation: The author rebuilt the useful half of the abandoned Text Format plugin, deliberately leaving out automatic format-on-save and the original's unrelated extras, and fixing its known bugs by design.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in commands for converting the case of selected text or repairing artifacts like hard-wrapped lines, hyphenated breaks, ligatures and invisible characters in text copied from PDFs or the web.

relations.evidence: This is a rebuild of the uncontested half of Text Format, whose last release was in July 2024.

summary: Selection-based text commands that change letter case (upper, title, camel, snake and more) and clean up prose pasted from PDFs, scans or web pages.
